[LSER.9.1.1] The engine tracks cumulative series state
(running stats, trailing tails, ring buffers, deques, reservoirs,
etc.) per entity per series. When total series memory
crosses an operator-set budget, the engine emits a warning and
a metric. No hard cap, no runtime rejection — the operator
decides how to respond (add memory, prune series, shorten
windows, retire rules that use rarely-referenced series).
